truth_definition: D_adj truth is one-half the squared L2 distance between the finite-depth measurement pair-state probabilities, including the declared quantization resolution. Kendall, Spearman and top10 Jaccard use the corresponding finite-depth population-mean ordering targets. Realized pair ties are reported separately.
stable_rule: Beta(plus+1, minus+1) 95% direction posterior with minimum strict support >=8; ties remain a third state.
interpretation: Calibration artifact only. It does not assert comparator superiority and is not mixed with empirical Frangieh results.
